description: Schedule a message to be delivered back into THIS SESSION at a future time. Delivery survives container restarts. Granularity is one minute.
name: mcp__claude-code-remote__send_later

at.description: RFC3339 timestamp for the fire time. Mutually exclusive with delay_minutes.

delay_minutes.description: Fire this many minutes from now. Minimum 1.

message.description: The text to deliver as a user turn.

name.description: Short human-readable label for this reminder.
